There must be NO profession filter dropdown above the middle material list; profession selection exists only in the sidebar. Keep the search field. Adjust spacing to fit without clipping. Todas las profesiones is the selected profession option. Delete the now empty footer bar and extend the list/content panels downward to use that area. No footer status indicator. Keep the tiny outside-frame caption 'Concepto visual · Datos de ejemplo'. This is a focused layout correction, not a redesign.
